items.name: IS530
items.marketingDescription:
The IS530 is a rugged, innovative and multifunctional smartphone for use in ATEX/IECEx zones 1, 2, 21, 22 and Class 1 Div1/Div2 along with a range of additional global explosion protection approvals.
The Devices improves ease of use to mobile workers in Oil & Gas, Chemical, Refining, Pharmaceuticals, and other hazardous industries.
The Android™ operating system enables the intrinsically safe device to work safely, quickly, and efficiently. 
The ISM interface of the IS530 can be used within hazardous areas with approved headsets, Remote Speaker Microphones (RSM) and other add-ons, making the smartphone a multifunctional equipment for industrial applications. 
The IS530 can be equipped with a memory SD card up to 128 GB, dual nano SIMs, has an amplified loudspeaker, a magnetic charging port, two cameras (13 MP rear camera with autofocus and 5 MP front camera) and a 4,5“ HD display.
Technologies like 2G/3G/4G (LTE), NFC, GPS, Bluetooth® 5.0 and 2.4GHz/5GHz Wi-Fi complete the performance.
